environment.description: Same ASP.NET Core 6.0 application deployed on Azure App Service behind Azure Front Door Premium with custom rule configuration. The Front Door profile has a rate limit rule (priority 1) configured as a custom WAF rule with match condition on RequestUri containing '/api/workflowstate/restore' using a rate limit threshold of 2 requests per 1-minute window per SocketAddr, with action type Block returning 429. Additionally, a second custom rule (priority 2) applies a request body inspection rule that blocks requests where the body size exceeds 4KB on this specific endpoint path, returning 403. The rate limit uses a sliding window with 1-minute granularity. Note: the WAF policy is in Prevention mode but only these two custom rules are active — no managed rulesets (OWASP/Microsoft defaults) are enabled. The application-level code is identical and BinaryFormatter remains enabled in the runtime.

config.network_restrictions: App Service only accepts traffic from Front Door (service tag AzureFrontDoor.Backend with Front Door ID header validation)
